detail.longDescription: Stanford's SNAP group has open-sourced Memorilla, a memory module that turns a whole document collection into 16 learned tokens for a frozen Qwen3-8B instead of full-context prompting. It scores 84.33 per cent on FactKG against 80.43 per cent for full context, using 108 times fewer document tokens. Code and checkpoints are Apache 2.0. https://www. marktechpost.com/2026/11/14/st anford-memorilla-memory-system-16-memory-tokens/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AIresearch
